name: Cocoa nib (winnowed, shell removed)
source: Winnowed nib (roasted bean minus shell): illustrative proximate (per kg) water 20 g, protein 128 g, fat 500 g (nib concentrates the bean's fat relative to the whole roasted bean, since shell carries little fat), carbohydrate 310 g, ash 42 g.
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. This is also the profile used for cocoa liquor: grinding the nib to liquor is a pure phase change (solid nib to a fluid paste at process temperature) with no mass loss, so liquor is carried in the ledger as this same substance, just melted, rather than a second near-duplicate file.
